title: The image of an orthogonal graph map is flat along its tangent plane
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, and let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝ^k. Let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^k, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, D ⊆ ℝⁿ an arbitrary set, and v₀ ∈ ℝⁿ with u differentiable at v₀. Put Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'u(v). Then for every ε > 0 there is ρ > 0 such that every y ∈ Φ(D) with dist(y, Φ(v₀)) < ρ admits some t ∈ range DΦ(v₀) with ‖y − Φ(v₀) − t‖ ≤ ε‖y − Φ(v₀)‖. Here DΦ(v₀) = fderiv ℝ Φ v₀, viewed as a linear map.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (v₀ : Euclid n), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → DifferentiableAt ℝ u v₀ → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' D, dist y (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀)) < ρ → ∃ t ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v₀ : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)), ‖y - (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀)) - t‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀))‖
